title: Native FTS vs BM25 sparse backend
finding: Task 4.1 evidence for `implement-native-sparse-backend-strategy`. G1 PASS (sparse Recall@10 parity 0.850/0.850, hybrid 0.950/0.950 on the Exp 9 corpus, 53 chunks), G2 PASS (both fully deterministic), G4 PASS (native peak RSS −7.4%), G3 FAIL (native warm p50 138.7× BM25: 5.7 ms vs ~0.04 ms in-process at this corpus scale; native cold start 10.8× faster). Decision per pre-registered rule: **keep `bm25` default**; native registered as capability-resolved alternative
